title: Lovely Algerian Danmuji Tagine
description: A savory Algerian dish featuring danmuji, perfect for a date night, with Mediterranean-friendly flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the danmuji, chickpeas, dried apricots, and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, this dish is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
You can also serve it with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple green salad.
